name: Ink bloom
description: Drops of ink released into still water: each bloom spreads on a diffusion curve, its boundary growing tendrils as it goes, and stacks with the others as pigment rather than paint. Slow and quiet — for intros, verses and comedowns.

feather.description: How soft the diffusion front is, as a fraction of the bloom's radius.

flow.description: Warp of the whole plane — the water moving, not the ink.
